Message.Name: NewOrderAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Submission of a new order to Cboe Australia

Message.Name: NewOrderAUEquitiesV2
Message.Description: Submission of a new order to Cboe Australia, with Post Only and multi-day order fields

Message.Name: ModifyOrderAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Request to modify an order

Message.Name: ModifyOrderAUEquitiesV2
Message.Description: Request to modify an order, with ExpireDate for multi-day orders

Message.Name: CancelOrderAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Request to cancel a single order

Message.Name: PurgeOrdersAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Request to cancel a group of orders across all of the participant's sessions

Message.Name: OrderAcknowledgementAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Order Acknowledgement messages are sent in response to a New Order message

Message.Name: OrderRejectedAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Order Rejected messages are sent in response to a New Order which must be rejected

Message.Name: OrderModifiedAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Order Modified messages are sent in response to a Modify Order to indicate that the order has been successfully modified

Message.Name: ModifyRejectedAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Modify Rejected messages are sent in response to a Modify Order for an order which cannot be modified

Message.Name: OrderRestatedAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Order restatement for an iceberg reload or a Self-Trade Protection reduction or cancellation

Message.Name: OrderExecutionAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: An Order Execution is sent for each fill on an order

Message.Name: OrderCancelledAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Order Cancelled message

Message.Name: CancelRejectedAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: A Cancel Rejected message is sent in response to a Cancel Order message to indicate that the cancellation cannot occur

Message.Name: ExecutionRestatementAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Order Execution Restated messages will be issued for all (unbroken) fills of MOC orders after the closing price has been determined

Message.Name: PurgeAcknowledgementAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: A Purge Acknowledgment is an unsequenced message sent when a Purge Orders message requesting an order purge has completed cancelling all individual orders

Message.Name: PurgeRejectedAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: A Purge Rejected message is sent in response to a Purge Orders message to indicate that the mass cancellation cannot occur

Message.Name: TradeCancelCorrectAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Used to provide notification that a trade has been cancelled (busted) or corrected (price change only)

Message.Name: OrderModifiedAUEquitiesV2
Message.Description: Order Modified messages are sent in response to a Modify Order, with ExpireDate for multi-day orders

Message.Name: CarriedRestatementAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: The Carried Restatement message is used to indicate the restoration of a multi-day GTC or GTD orders at the start of a new business day

Message.Name: DoneForDayAUEquitiesV1
Message.Description: Done For Day messages represent orders persisted during the current day session to carry over to the next session

Type.Name: Account
Type.Description: Used by a trading participant to provide a broker cross reference

Type.Name: BaseLiquidityIndicator
Type.Description: Indicates whether the trade added or removed liquidity

Type.Name: BrokerPreferencing
Type.Description: Broker preferencing instruction

Type.Name: CancelledOrderCount
Type.Description: Number of orders cancelled

Type.Name: CancelOrigOnReject
Type.Description: Cancel original order if modification fails

Type.Name: CancelReason
Type.Description: See Section 4.4 - Order Reason Codes

Type.Name: CancelRejectReason
Type.Description: See Section 4.4 - Order Reason Codes

Type.Name: Capacity
Type.Description: The capacity for the order. Required on all orders

Type.Name: ClearingAccount
Type.Description: Supplemental identifier

Type.Name: ClearingParticipantID
Type.Description: The CHESS clearing participant identifier. Must be a valid 5-digit CHESS PID

Type.Name: ClientCrossRef
Type.Description: Can be used to provide additional participant-side cross reference information

Type.Name: ClOrdID
Type.Description: Unique Id chosen by the participant

Type.Name: ContraParticipantID
Type.Description: Trading Participant Identifier (PID) of the counter party on a trade. 0 If unattributed

Type.Name: CorrectedPrice
Type.Description: The corrected price of the trade, or 0 for a trade cancellation

Type.Name: DirectedWholesaleIndicator
Type.Description: Market Integrity Rule defined field to identify wholesale participant

Type.Name: DisplayIndicator
Type.Description: Treatment of Post Only orders on entry if creating a locked NBBO

Type.Name: ExecId
Type.Description: Execution Id. Unique across all matching units on a given day

Type.Name: ExecInst
Type.Description: All values not defined below are rejected. Ignored if blank (0x00)

Type.Name: ExecRefId
Type.Description: Refers to the ExecId of the fill being cancelled or corrected

Type.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Type.Description: The reason for this Order Execution Restated message

Type.Name: ExpireTime
Type.Description: Required for GTD order (TimeInForce = 6), ExpireTime specifies the date-time (in UTC) when the order expires

Type.Name: ExpireDate
Type.Description: Only applicable for TimeInForce (59) = 6 (GTD) orders. Specifies the date on which a GTD order will expire

Type.Name: FeeCode
Type.Description: Indicates fee associated with an execution

Type.Name: IntermediaryID
Type.Description: Market Integrity Rule defined field for Intermediary Identifier

Type.Name: LastCapacity
Type.Description: Capacity of the order

Type.Name: LastMkt
Type.Description: Supported MIC code values

Type.Name: LastPx
Type.Description: Price of this fill

Type.Name: LastShares
Type.Description: Executed quantity

Type.Name: LeavesQty
Type.Description: Quantity still open for further execution. If zero, the order is complete

Type.Name: MassCancelID
Type.Description: User-defined identifier of the mass cancel or purge request

Type.Name: MassCancelInst
Type.Description: At least one character must be provided (PID Filter)

Type.Name: MaxFloor

Type.Name: MEQSE

Type.Name: MinQty
Type.Description: Minimum fill quantity for orders

Type.Name: ModifyRejectReason
Type.Description: See Section 4.4 - Order Reason Codes

Type.Name: OnMarketCrossType
Type.Description: Type of on-market crossing

Type.Name: OrderID
Type.Description: Order identifier supplied by Cboe Australia

Type.Name: OrderQty

Type.Name: OrderRejectReason
Type.Description: See Section 4.4 - Order Reason Codes

Type.Name: OrdType
Type.Description: Order type

Type.Name: OrigClOrdID
Type.Description: The ClOrdID of the original order

Type.Name: OriginOfTrans
Type.Description: Market Integrity Rule defined field for Origin of Order (ex. ACN, ABN, CHESS HIN)

Type.Name: OrigTime
Type.Description: TransactionTime of the original trade

Type.Name: Price
Type.Description: Price of the order

Type.Name: PriceImprovement
Type.Description: Amount of price improvement against the primary best bid/offer at the time of execution

Type.Name: PurgeRejectReason
Type.Description: Reason for the purge rejection. See Section 4.4 - Order Reason Codes

Type.Name: RemoveCrossingFromClearing
Type.Description: If Y, instructs Cboe Australia on how to process crossed trades with CHESS

Type.Name: RestatementReason
Type.Description: The reason for this Order Restated message

Type.Name: RiskGroupIdCnt
Type.Description: Number of repeating RiskGroupID included in this message. Value 0 to 10

Type.Name: RoutingInst
Type.Description: Indicates the order is a Post Only order

Type.Name: SecondaryOrderID
Type.Description: Alternative Cboe OrderId: contra side of a prevented match, or the displayed portion of an iceberg order

Type.Name: ShortSellCoveredQty
Type.Description: Defines the portion of OrderQty (38) that is covered

Type.Name: ShortSellLongQty
Type.Description: Defines the portion of OrderQty (38) that is owned by the participant who placed the order

Type.Name: Side
Type.Description: Side of the order

Type.Name: SourceMatchingUnit
Type.Description: The matching unit reporting the purge

Type.Name: SubLiquidityIndicator
Type.Description: Additional information about the liquidity of an order

Type.Name: Symbol
Type.Description: Instrument symbol (upper case alphanumeric)

Type.Name: TargetMatchingUnit
Type.Description: Matching unit to which the purge should be restricted. Zero is considered all matching engines

Type.Name: Text

Type.Name: TimeInForce
Type.Description: Time in force

Type.Name: TradeReportType

Type.Name: TradingParticipantID
Type.Description: The (4 digit) trading participant identifier

Type.Name: TransactID
Type.Description: Transaction Identifier as sent to CHESS for this order execution

Type.Name: TransactionTime
Type.Description: The time the event occurred in the Matching Engine (not the time the message was sent)

Type.Name: Undisclosed
Type.Description: If true, indicates an undisclosed order

Type.Name: WorkingPrice
Type.Description: The Price at which an order is effectively working in the book
